summary.text: One of the twenty-three suitors from Same on Cephallenia in Apollodorus' island catalogue — attested only in the Epitome, and not to be confused with later historical or philosophical bearers of the name.

story.text: Apollodorus names Antisthenes among the wooers who came from Same, listed after Pheroetes and before Cerberus in the catalogue of those who devoured Odysseus' house.
